test: CodexHarnessAdapter > a turn that arrives before any options probe still names its effort and tier
invariant: Without a prior probe, turn/start still resolves model+effort+serviceTier.
replacement: KEEP(cold-start ordering: model list loaded on demand for the first turn)

test: CodexHarnessAdapter > every turn names a concrete model and effort, so nothing carries over from the last one
invariant: A "default" prompt resolves to the model list's default row and its default effort on turn/start.
replacement: KEEP(request param shape: default resolves concretely)

test: CodexHarnessAdapter > a hidden model still has its effort confirmed
invariant: A hidden model's requested effort is honored on turn/start.

test: CodexHarnessAdapter > refuses a level the model does not offer instead of running without it
invariant: Requesting an unsupported effort produces no turn/start and an event naming "does not run gpt-5.5 at effort xhigh; it accepts low, high".
replacement: KEEP(config validation: unsupported effort fails the turn by name)

test: CodexHarnessAdapter > exposes the selected Codex model's fast tier as a service_tier option
invariant: probeConfigOptions surfaces serviceTiers as a service_tier select option only for models that declare one.

test: CodexHarnessAdapter > a requested tier "priority" reaches turn/start as "priority"
invariant: A supported serviceTier is passed through to turn/start.
notes: test.each row 1 of 3.

test: CodexHarnessAdapter > a requested tier null reaches turn/start as null
invariant: An unset serviceTier still sends serviceTier:null on turn/start.
replacement: KEEP(request param shape: serviceTier always present)
notes: test.each row 2 of 3.

test: CodexHarnessAdapter > a requested tier "flex" reaches turn/start as null
invariant: An unknown serviceTier squashes to null on turn/start.
replacement: KEEP(request param shape: unknown tier null-squashed)
notes: test.each row 3 of 3.

test: CodexHarnessAdapter > answers the app-server refresh request from its own ChatGPT auth file
invariant: An account/chatgptAuthTokens/refresh request is answered with fresh tokens from the OAuth endpoint, the exchange sends the stale refresh_token, and auth.json is rewritten with access/refresh/id_token in the isolated home.
notes: Credential renewal during a session; keep the persisted id_token assertion (codex >=0.143 refuses auth.json without it).

test: CodexHarnessAdapter > an approval storage failure replies to the provider and does not strand the public turn
invariant: If appending the permission.asked event throws, request 901 gets a -32603 error reply (never a result), the turn still reaches session.idle, and listPermissions is empty.
replacement: KEEP(persistence failure during approval — save-before-release; fault-injected write)
notes: H3b's Codex analog; guards the failed-write path.

test: CodexHarnessAdapter > MCP consent preserves the advertised choice accept
invariant: An mcp_tool_call elicitation projects as a permission whose options include "accept"; answering allow_once+accept replies {action:"accept",content:{},_meta:null}.
notes: MCP-consent-as-permission; canonical id differs from native id 901. Loop case 1 of 5.

test: CodexHarnessAdapter > MCP consent preserves the advertised choice decline
invariant: Decline answers {action:"decline",content:null,_meta:null}.
notes: Loop case 2 of 5.

test: CodexHarnessAdapter > MCP consent preserves the advertised choice cancel
invariant: Cancel answers {action:"cancel",content:null,_meta:null}.
notes: Loop case 3 of 5.

test: CodexHarnessAdapter > MCP consent preserves the advertised choice {"persist":"session"}
invariant: A persist:session option answers {action:"accept",content:{},_meta:{persist:"session"}}.
notes: Loop case 4 of 5; persist grant scope.

test: CodexHarnessAdapter > MCP consent preserves the advertised choice {"persist":"always"}
invariant: A persist:always option answers {action:"accept",content:{},_meta:{persist:"always"}}.
notes: Loop case 5 of 5.

test: CodexHarnessAdapter > projects MCP URL elicitations as questions and returns the user's acceptance
invariant: A url-mode mcpServer/elicitation/request projects as a question whose options invite confirmation; replying answers the elicitation {action:"accept"}.
notes: URL consent elicitation; canonical question id differs from native id 901.

test: CodexHarnessAdapter > fails Codex turns on provider auth 401 stderr instead of hanging
invariant: A 401 written to stderr ends the turn with an event carrying "Codex authentication failed with 401 Unauthorized".
notes: Guards 0f53c6fd67; refused-credential negative ends the turn by name.

test: CodexHarnessAdapter > admits native subAgentActivity once and routes its child transcript separately
invariant: A subAgentActivity item yields one child session, running->completed lifecycle under one subagentKey, and the child's delta lands only in the child's store.
notes: Native input: subAgentActivity items + foreign-thread delta; guards f69bde5308 / 0c8b26ccd1.

test: CodexHarnessAdapter > routes Codex child threads through revisioned lifecycle admission into isolated stores
invariant: collabAgentToolCall spawn/send/close items produce per-child sessions (agent_session_id = native thread id), revision-numbered subagent-updated events with spawn/interaction roles, and child-only deltas land only in the child's store.
notes: Keep the revision sequence assertion (1..n per child) and store isolation.

test: CodexHarnessAdapter > folds a thread started beneath a subagent, at any depth, into that first-level subagent's session
invariant: Grandchild and deeper threads' deltas and per-turn usage fold into the first-level child's session; the child's session.idle lands after its last frame.
notes: Nested folding + per-scope usage; idle ordering after last frame.

test: CodexHarnessAdapter > meters each Codex thread on its own session while another session's turn shares the app-server
invariant: Interleaved frames for two sessions on one app-server meter usage per session and no foreign content leaks into either store.
notes: Multi-session isolation on a shared process; cumulative tokenUsage deltas metered per turn.
